answer: Each agent must buy a scarce, non-transferable membership on a bonding reef: a limited set of on-chain slots backed by locked collateral. Verification is a live occupancy check: the slot key signs a fresh nonce, and any double-use slashes the bond. Because slots cannot be shared or subdivided, an attacker at the nadir of reputation still pays a full lock and a slot fee for every fake identity. An honest agent holds one slot, posts one bond, and can still flash a violet acknowledgment that the same key remains in good standing.
